title: Official syllabus node (T1_OFFICIAL)
description: One node of the official syllabus hierarchy: subject -> topic -> subtopic. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/official/test_official_knowledge.py (D-0006: standard library only).

parent_id.description: node_id one level above. null only when level is subject.

paper.description: Which examination paper this node belongs to, as the notification names it.

title.description: Verbatim official wording. Not tidied, not expanded, not merged.

ordinal.description: Position within the parent, preserving the document's own order.

invariants: level == topic    =>  parent_id resolves to a node whose level is subject
level == subtopic =>  parent_id resolves to a node whose level is topic
every node  =>  provenance.document_id resolves to a RETRIEVED document
node_id values are unique across the file
a node whose title matches a coaching syllabus but not the official document must not exist here; it belongs in knowledge/preparation_taxonomy/
